notes.title: Turbo Cat Fight
notes.notes: This is a recap stream on Turbo Cat Fight livestreams on Steam Next Fest. It loops the contest stream, the Q&A stream, as well as some filler gameplay.

notes.title: Turbo Cat Fight Q&A
notes.notes:
Turbo Cat Fight is an Experimental Pixel Perfect fighting game and it's coming out on Feb 14th, but what even is Turbo Cat Fight? Is it about cats? What's so special about being pixel perfect?

On February 8th the stream will be joined by [url=https://twitter.com/96lions_]Sophie[/url] of Kakuchopurei, who will be asking interviewing me([url=https://twitter.com/Schaosmore]Chaosmore[/url]) regarding Turbo Cat Fight! I'll also be answering chat questions, so be sure to tune in and ask me about it! See you soon!

notes.title: Turbo Cat Fight CONTEST STREAM!
notes.notes:
Hey there, you onlookers!

Look over the curb here, found them fuzzies hissing at each other? That's us and that's what happening today. We're here because because we love the lawless nature of mutual combat! But if you're curious about what Turbo Cat Fight is, then you're in LUCK! We're here for that too!

This contest stream will showcase some gameplay of Turbo Cat Fight, which is an Experimental Pixel Perfect fighting game. The contestants fight to keep the cat ear, and the winner keeps the cat ears AND THEIR TERRITORY.

Check out the game page for more info!
